## Validation

List exact commands, environments/versions and results. Distinguish offline
checks from observed app/device/browser outcomes; state anything unverified.
See [development checks](../docs/development.md).

## Release notes

Suggested summary and category: fix / enhancement / documentation / maintenance.
Maintainers: apply `breaking-change` where user action is required. A PR merge
is not a release or deployment.

- [ ] Tests/checks appropriate to this change completed; limitations listed above.
- [ ] Relevant docs/change notes updated, or not applicable.
- [ ] Logs/fixtures/screenshots contain no credentials, identifiers or private URLs.
